name: protocol-extraction-from-implementations
description: Extract a complete communication protocol specification from an existing open-source implementation. Produces a standalone reference with message formats, state machine, timing, and an implementation checklist.

config.instruction: Survey known implementations. Rank by completeness, test coverage, and deployment count. Identify the key source files in the best implementation.
Extract every message format from the source code: field names, bit positions, byte ordering, scaling, offset, valid ranges, and integrity field algorithms.
Extract the protocol state machine: states, transitions, timing requirements, rate limits, and error handling paths.
Assemble into a self-contained specification with byte-level diagrams, transition tables, timing tables, and an implementation checklist.
